docs.title: Getting Started
docs.description: Set up the PokéBedrock wiki repo locally and publish your first doc change.
docs.body:
## 1. Clone & Install

<ShellBlock command="git clone git@github.com:pokebedrock/wiki.git\ncd wiki\nnpm ci" />

## 2. Create a Branch

<ShellBlock command="git checkout -b docs/my-topic" />
